representations.name: root-state alternating reserve digraph
representations.new_information: A state records the chosen root of every repeated colour, its concrete base pairs, exact canonical reserves K(e), current matching, and graph-legal root switches.
representations.repairs_loss: It distinguishes rearrangement inside a fixed two-token reserve from a switch that reaches a previously unused missing B-edge.
representations.first_test: Replay all root choices on the n=14 tight graph; reject every purported augmentation that ends at bc or cz or at a formal dummy.
representations.public_effect: A rank-increasing reachable state for every deficient cut could create the missing B capacity.

representations.name: cut-labelled augmenting forest
representations.new_information: Every tree is rooted at a minimal deficient demand cut and labels each transition by the actual missing edge newly entering that cut's neighbourhood.
representations.repairs_loss: It forces augmentation to address the witnessing cut rather than only increase a global candidate count.
representations.first_test: Search for terminal strongly connected cut states on small canonical-reserve graphs and the exact n=14 model.
representations.public_effect: Absence of terminal deficient components would imply iterative full payment.

representations.name: owned rectangle absorber catalogue
representations.new_information: An absorber stores an owned A diagonal, its anticomplete rectangle, a concrete unused missing B-edge, and the C7 switch proving that edge legal for one named demand.
representations.repairs_loss: It prevents an A atom or a merely missing pair from being counted without a conversion certificate.
representations.first_test: Enumerate whether any owned diagonal of the n=14 circuit has an absorber output outside {bc,cz}.
representations.public_effect: A disjoint absorber for every residual demand would close each Hall cut.

representations.name: reserved absorber hypergraph
representations.new_information: Hyperedges join a demand, its source A rectangle, all C7 witness edges, and one output missing B-edge; overlap degree is retained explicitly.
representations.repairs_loss: It separates raw reservoir size from a matching of vertex-disjoint, nonreused actual absorbers.
representations.first_test: Shared-output and shared-witness blow-ups test whether a large catalogue can still have absorber matching rank one.
representations.public_effect: A bounded-codegree absorber matching theorem could pay the sparse leftover after a partial allocation.

representations.name: common-ground transversal exchange system
representations.new_information: The ground elements are concrete missing B-edges; one independence system is reserve-matchability and another encodes exclusive ownership of the graph operation producing each legal arc.
representations.repairs_loss: A and B ranks are never added across different shores; any gain is a genuine basis exchange on B-edge elements.
representations.first_test: Check basis exchange and augmentation on the n=14 tight graph and all small B-reserve systems; kill if A owners raise formal rank but no B element enters.
representations.public_effect: A verified matroid-intersection rank inequality could preserve exchange rank globally.

representations.name: gammoid of C7 switch paths
representations.new_information: Sources are unmatched demands, sinks are unused actual missing B-edges, and directed paths are explicit graph operations with vertex capacities for ownership and C7 witnesses.
representations.repairs_loss: It makes exchange rank equal to a disjoint path packing only when each path has an original-graph realization.
representations.first_test: The n=14 graph must have no sink beyond its occupied full reserve; a dummy sink is disallowed.
representations.public_effect: A min-cut lower bound in this gammoid could yield the required rank.

representations.name: odd-cycle root-rotation complex
representations.new_information: Cells are root choices in independent outer endpoint sets Y_gamma; faces record simultaneous rotations whose base pairs and C7 completion witnesses remain legal.
representations.repairs_loss: It realizes uncrossing as changes of concrete base pairs rather than union/intersection of abstract Hall sets.
representations.first_test: On two-endpoint colours in the n=14 graph, verify that root reversal leaves base bc and K(bc) unchanged and hence creates no carrier.
representations.public_effect: A rotation escaping every tight reserve circuit would enlarge cut neighbourhoods.

representations.name: laminar rotation-circuit ledger
representations.new_information: Crossing deficient cuts may be uncrossed only when one explicit simultaneous root rotation preserves every demand incidence and releases a new edge with a unique owner.
representations.repairs_loss: It exposes precisely where ordinary submodular uncrossing lacks a graph exchange axiom.
representations.first_test: Enumerate crossing cuts with identical bases; kill lossless laminarization if their deficits persist under all legal rotations.
representations.public_effect: A laminar family with one distinct escape edge per leaf could globalize carrier creation.

representations.name: canonical-reserve nibble with codegrees
representations.new_information: The probability space samples actual demand-to-reserve incidences; degrees, pair codegrees, identical-base classes, and occupied edges are retained.
representations.repairs_loss: It blocks independence heuristics when many demands have the same K(e).
representations.first_test: The n=14 triple has pair codegree two equal to degree two, so any claimed low-codegree nibble must reject it.
representations.public_effect: Graph-derived low codegrees could match most demands while preserving a deterministic cleanup reservoir.

representations.name: nibble leftover cut potential
representations.new_information: Tracks the maximum remaining Hall deficiency over all cuts after each semi-random round, together with an untouched set of concrete missing B-edges.
representations.repairs_loss: Expected matched size cannot hide one unserved correlated deficient component.
representations.first_test: Run exact outcome enumeration on the three-demand/two-carrier circuit; maximum cut deficiency must remain at least one in every outcome.
representations.public_effect: A contraction of maximum cut deficiency plus actual cleanup would close the payment interface.
